item.title: The great myth is that listening equals legitimacy

item.title: Higher education postcard: critical faculties
item.description: This week’s card from Hugh Jones’ postbag helps sort out some organisational terminology

item.title: Now the struggle is no longer real, are students becoming stupid?

item.title: Why research communications needs more politics

item.description: For Rex McKenzie, higher education assessment has always privileged certain discourses – but the rise of artificial intelligence means that this can no longer hold

item.title: Why aren’t there more accelerated degree apprenticeships?
item.description: Accelerated degree apprenticeships speak to the current policy moment in England – but there are clear challenges with rolling these programmes out. Charlynne Pullen and Claire Wolstenholme have been investigating
